messages:
lee: quick proposal — for tenants with PII/data-residency constraints, pin "write affinity" to a single region for a short TTL (default 10m) after an authoritative write. replicate async to other regions with an anti-entropy pass for eventual convergence. aims: lower cross-region sync latency for critical writes and avoid accidental cross-region writes during short bursts.

anita: sounds reasonable as a default. question: how do we guarantee read-after-write for clients routed to a different region immediately after the write?

jordan: can we do a read-forwarding step within TTL? i.e., if region B gets a read and the tenant's write-lock TTL is active in region A, forward the read to A or return a not-ready hint. forwarding has perf cost but preserves semantics.

samir: cost note: read-forwarding spikes inter-region traffic. also need to be careful re: HA — if region A is down we must fallback. do we have a graceful degrade plan?

lee: fallback plan idea: if region A fails, allow a temporary lease transfer to a hot standby region after a 30s probe + quorum check. transfer should be guarded by a lease-version vector to prevent split-brain. transfer path is only for outage windows, not normal traffic.

anita: for conflict resolution we should avoid ad-hoc merges for PII metadata. prefer last-writer-with-lease or reject second writes during TTL. for user-visible data we can merge, but for policy flags we must prefer authoritative region.

jordan: implementation sketch: store a small metadata row per tenant: {home_region, lease_id, lease_expiry, version}. use version vectors for async replicas. anti-entropy job runs hourly (configurable) to reconcile missed updates. if a write arrives at non-home region and lease active -> reject 409 with hint: "home_region=<region>; lease_expiry=<ts>" so SDKs can retry to correct region.

samir: SDK/edge change required: include support for 409 hints + automatic redirect for signed requests. Ops needs metrics: cross-region reject rate, forwarded read ratio, lease-transfer incidents.

infra-bot: CI check: added schema migration draft PR #5402. run: migration dry-run in staging at 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

lee: follow-ups: 1) anita/jordan to write short RFC with lease lifecycle + transfer protocol (owner: anita) 2) samir to wire required metrics into console (owner: samir) 3) infra to run migration dry-run and report errors (owner: infra). target: prototype in staging in 3 weeks.

anita: one more constraint — legal asked that any tenant with EU-only residency must never get a lease transfer without explicit manual approval. will add flag in tenant metadata.

jordan: ack. will add flag to RFC and add an e2e test for the manual approval path.

lee: ok. thanks all. closing thread unless someone wants to add objections now. :thumbsup:
